title: Reconstruction from the last coordinate
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, and let $a\in\{−1,1\}$. Then $f(x,a)=f_{\mathrm{even}}(x)+a f_{\mathrm{odd}}(x)$, where $f_{\mathrm{even}}$ and $f_{\mathrm{odd}}$ are the averages and half-differences of the two values obtained by setting the last coordinate to $1$ and $-1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
